questions.stem: What does it mean when electric field lines are drawn closer together?

options.text: The field is uniform in that region
The field is stronger in that region
The field is weaker in that region

questions.explanation: When electric field lines are drawn closer together, this indicates a stronger electric field in that region. The density of field lines represents the field strength. In a uniform field (such as between parallel plates), the lines are evenly spaced.
